title: P0 SECRETS HOLE: gitreins guard misses non-sk- secrets when gitleaks is on PATH — gitreins init generates .gitleaks.toml with only the custom sk-api-key rule, gitleaks runs with --config overriding its built-in rules, and the built-in Python scanner (AWS/GitHub/GitLab patterns) is never reached (OR vs AND). Reproduced: planted AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=AKIA1234567890ABCDEF in a staged .env -> guard reported "secrets — clean". Every repo using gitreins as its quality gate inherits this blind spot. Fix: include all built-in patterns in generated .gitleaks.toml, or run gitleaks AND the built-in scanner, or drop --config. PASS: echo 'AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=AKIA1234567890ABCDEF' > .env && git add .env && gitreins guard -> FAILS on secrets.
